info.title: Porch RPC Profile
info.description: A PROFILE (strict subset) of the Ethereum JSON-RPC API as defined by ethereum/execution-apis. Porch V0 serves only the methods listed here, with the per-method caps in `x-porch`. Method params/results are NOT redefined here: the canonical schema for each method is the one in execution-apis. Verify a Porch node against the allowlisted methods for free with hive's `rpc-compat` suite.
info.x-porch-note: This file is normative for WHICH methods Porch serves and their caps. It is NOT normative for method shapes — execution-apis is.

x-porch-tiers.probe: Served free, unauthenticated, IP/connection rate-limited (DoS floor, spec §7/#23).
x-porch-tiers.paid: Requires a valid payment ticket (or, for free-tier nodes, an RLN spam stake).

x-porch-excluded.eth_getLogs: Unbounded cost with wide ranges — excluded until per-method pricing exists (V2).

x-porch-reserved.eth_getProof: NOT served in V0. Reserved for the Correctness layer (V2): the node returns a Merkle proof the sidecar verifies against a trusted header. Schema: execution-apis eth_getProof.
